summary: SB Dépannage (towing) refonte — full backend + frontend E2E validated. 11/11 backend tests pass (problem catalog, estimate w/ night surcharge, create with auto-assigned operator, live progression searching→en_route→arrived, complete with wallet debit + idempotency, insufficient balance 400, cancel, history). Frontend E2E pass: login → /towing → 7 problem types in problem-grid → battery flow → towing-details (my-position, vehicle, sbpay) → 50€ estimate → request → towing-tracking with timeline + operator-card (Karim B. Dépann'Express) + SOS → arrived at ~42s → towing-complete-btn → towing-done screen (50€ debited). History page lists past requests (13 items). Directory regression /towing-partners renders towing-page with 4 partner cards.

issues: Pickup input shows 'Ma position actuelle' as plain text after geolocation rather than reverse-geocoded address — acceptable but a real address would be cleaner

critical_code_review_comments: towing.py: cashback award wrapped in bare try/except Exception with silent pass — fine for non-blocking but should log warning.
complete_request: uses atomic conditional update on wallets ($gte:total) which correctly prevents oversell — good.
Idempotency relies on payment_status check before debit — verified no double debit via test_complete_debits_wallet retry.
_live_state computes status from elapsed time on read — no background job needed, scales well; ARRIVE_SECONDS=45 is hard-coded (acceptable for demo, but make configurable for prod).
_assign_operator uses md5 hash of req_id for deterministic operator selection — OK for sim; replace with real dispatch later as noted in docstring.
TowingRequestPage.js: poll every 3s in tracking — fine for demo, switch to SSE/WS later.
No backend route to upload damage photos / add user signature on completion — could be future enhancement.
